grasp_res = grasp(best_c)
if not grasp_res.get("holding_something", False):

go_home()
check("purple_mug", "blue_coaster")

obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["cyan_pen"]
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_pen")
# Look for candidate along the long axis, or use top surface height
cand = None
for c in candidates:
    # Check if fingers squeeze along long axis (footprint ~0.067m < 0.08m)
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True) and abs(c["squeeze_width"] - pen["footprint_long"]) < 0.02:
        cand = c
        break

if cand is None:
    # Pick a high grasp candidate near top surface (~0.12m)
    cand = candidates[0].copy()
    cand["height"] = min(pen["height"] - 0.01, 0.12)
    # Align yaw along the pen's long axis so fingers clamp the ends or orient appropriately
    cand["yaw"] = pen["long_axis_yaw"]
    cand["squeeze_width"] = pen["footprint_long"]

res = grasp(cand)
if not res.get("holding_something", False):
    # Fallback to candidate 1 with high height
    c2 = candidates[1] if len(candidates) > 1 else candidates[0]
    c2_mod = c2.copy()
    c2_mod["height"] = 0.12
    res = grasp(c2_mod)

if res.get("holding_something", False):
    drop_into_container_v2("cyan_pen", "magenta_holder", safe_z_offset=0.08)

go_home()
